operation.summary: The satellites (other Bridgit phones linked to this one) you may use, with what each offers. Any call takes header X-Bridgit-Target: <satellite id> (or query target=<id>) to run on that satellite instead of this phone; leave it out to use this phone.
operation.returns: satellites[{id (sat:…), name, status (online|offline|unlinked|not_checked), last_seen (ms, 0 = never), battery{percent, charging}, model, device_type (phone, tablet, computer, tv, watch or camera; null from an older satellite), app_version, cameras[{id, target_camera}], capabilities[{id, enabled, ready, blocked_reason}], endpoints[{method, path}], how_to_call}], how_to_call. Only satellites the owner lets you use are listed.
